Plex currently needs atlas (it runs as a Docker container there) and tank (library on tank/media, appdata on tank/appdata). The titan dependency is superseded history.

If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint on it stops (direct dependency), and the wiki search service on hermes degrades: new pages are not embedded, though keyword search still works (second hop). No other lab page names titan as a current dependency.
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (it runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot) and gate (internet access to upload).
The hermes VM needs atlas (it runs on and stops with atlas) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains; it cannot boot without tank).

If atlas stops, the Syncthing sync of the notes folder to pebble stops: Syncthing runs on atlas directly, and it reaches pebble only over Tailscale, which itself runs on atlas (pebble depends on tailscale, tailscale depends on atlas).

Direct dependents of gate: the reverse proxy (outside access), Tailscale (internet), the rclone backup (upload), aria (network features) and atlas's Unraid email notifications. Second hop via Tailscale: remote access to pebble, hermes and Plex, and Syncthing's sync to pebble.

Directly, the wiki search service needs hermes; indirectly, hermes needs atlas and tank (it runs on atlas and its vdisk is on tank). The Ollama endpoint on titan is only needed for embeddings, so keyword search still works without it.

If atlas shuts down it takes with it the hermes VM, the tank pool, and the Plex, Caddy reverse proxy, Syncthing and rclone backup services on it, plus the Tailscale exit node/subnet route; wiki search on hermes goes down via hermes.

If tank is unavailable while atlas runs, directly affected are Plex (library and appdata on tank), Syncthing (notes sync stops, so pebble stops receiving notes) and the rclone backup (no snapshot to read), plus hermes, which cannot boot without tank. Through hermes, the wiki search service stops too.

If hermes is down, the wiki search service (qmd) stops, the 02:30 nightly index rebuild does not run so the index goes stale, the wiki repo at /srv/wiki is unavailable, and pebble cannot reach hermes remotely.
